name: sirius-ai
description: Multi-model AI assistant for Sirius IDE — supports Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, and local Ollama models. Features: Thinking mode, Tool use, Image generation, Inline chat.

enumDescriptions: OpenRouter — one key, hundreds of models

sirius.ai.defaultModel.description: Model used for AI chat. Prefer the "Sirius: Select AI Model" command, which lists everything the configured providers offer.

sirius.ai.gemini.apiKey.description: Google Gemini API key (get one from ai.google.dev)
sirius.ai.gemini.apiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Storing API keys in settings.json is insecure — the file is plaintext, is picked up by Settings Sync and is captured by dotfile backups. Sirius now keeps keys in the system keyring. Any key left here is moved automatically on startup and this setting is cleared. Use the **Sirius: Set API Key** command instead.
sirius.ai.gemini.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: keys are now stored in the system keyring. Run "Sirius: Set API Key" instead.

sirius.ai.thinking.enabled.description: Enable thinking/reasoning mode for supported models (Claude Opus, Sonnet, Gemini 3.5)

enumDescriptions: Extra high — best for coding and agentic work
Max — maximum depth, when correctness beats cost
sirius.ai.thinking.effort.description: How deeply the AI should reason before responding

sirius.ai.temperature.description: AI response creativity (0 = deterministic, 2 = very creative)

sirius.ai.streamResponses.description: Stream AI responses token by token

sirius.ai.openai.baseUrl.description: Override the OpenAI endpoint — e.g. an Azure deployment or a corporate proxy.

sirius.ai.custom.baseUrl.description: Base URL of any other OpenAI-compatible service, including the /v1 suffix.
